q: Why would you run your agent on a VPS instead of only your laptop?
options: A VPS makes the agent smarter automatically
A VPS never sleeps, so your agent is reachable 24/7 even when your laptop is closed
A VPS gives you more model options
A laptop cannot run Hermes at all
explanation: A VPS never sleeps, so the gateway stays up and you can reach your agent from anywhere, any time.

q: Which is the cheapest sensible starting point for a Nigerian user?
options: A personal laptop with no VPS
explanation: Oracle Cloud's always-free Arm tier is a genuinely free, reliable starting point. Recheck current pricing before purchase.

q: How do you keep the gateway running after you log out of the VPS?
options: You cannot; it stops when you log out
Run it as a system service (systemd) via the gateway install command
Keep the SSH session open forever
explanation: Running the gateway as a system service (systemd) makes it start on boot and restart if it crashes.

q: What is a minimum security step for a VPS exposed to the internet?
options: Skip security; it's a personal agent
Use SSH keys and keep system updates applied
explanation: At minimum, use SSH keys, keep the system updated, and never expose secrets. A server on the internet must be hardened.
